name: Put Christmas Tree Spread (1x3, uncovered)
summary: Buy 1 ATM put and sell 3 further-OTM puts at one lower strike; the put mirror of the uncovered call christmas tree, with two naked short puts and a catastrophic-but-bounded downside.
max_profit: net credit + (long strike - short strike) x 100, realized exactly at the short strike
max_loss: Bounded only by a zero underlying: (3 x short strike - long strike - credit per share) x 100. On a $100 stock with shorts at $90 that is roughly $17,000 per unit.
breakevens: upper = long strike + credit per share (none, it profits above); lower = short strike - [(long - short) + credit per share] / 2

greeks.delta: negative at entry, flips sharply positive below the short strike

when_to_use: INCLUDED FOR COMPLETENESS ONLY - DO NOT TRADE IN THIS SYSTEM. The symmetric partner of the call 1x3 already in the bank; retained so the router has a slug to reject rather than an unknown structure.
entry_rules: BLOCKED: 2 of the 3 short puts are uncovered; requires Alpaca options level 4. Reject at the order-router layer.
If ever enabled: IV rank > 70, short strike |delta| <= 0.15, and a sell-stop hedge in the underlying below the lower breakeven.
Never confuse with put-christmas-tree-butterfly (1-3-2, defined risk, level 3) - the slugs must stay strictly separate.
management_rules: N/A at level 3. If enabled: close at 50% of credit; close unconditionally if spot trades within 0.5 x (long strike - short strike) of the short strike.
exit_rules: If ever enabled: flatten by 15:45 ET on expiration day and immediately on any ITM short put with extrinsic < $0.10.
assignment_risk: Three short puts, two of them naked: assignment buys 300 shares while the single long put hedges only 100. On a $50k account that is an immediate margin event.
buying_power: Naked put margin on 2 contracts plus the long put's cost; a single SPY unit would consume most of the account.
common_mistakes: Reading '1x3' as defined risk because the loss is technically bounded at a zero underlying.
family: Completeness gap-fill (cross-family): ratio/naked-financed put and call structures, quantity-unbalanced condors and strangles, stock+option overlays and monetizations, capital-protection and hybrid builds, 0DTE four-leg income, volatility-surface and relative-value trades, event-driven overlays, and roll/adjustment structures
blocked_because: needs Alpaca options level 4; this account is level 3. Alpaca rejects it with 'account not eligible to trade uncovered option contracts'. Raising the level is an Alpaca approval, not a code change.
